mapper.insert: insert into platform_user_tenant_role (id, user_id, tenant_id, role_id, created_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{roleId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: delete from platform_user_tenant_role where user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and role_id = #{roleId}
delete from platform_user_tenant_role where user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: select utr.role_id from platform_user_tenant_role utr inner join platform_role r on r.id = utr.role_id and r.deleted_at is null and r.status = 1 and r.scope = 'TENANT' where utr.user_id = #{userId} and utr.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
